name: Furry Boss 💼
source:
Furry Boss is a kinetic novel about which can be described as a compilation of comedy stories about a simple clerk and his everyday work with his new boss, Nina.

Nina is quite an unusual boss - she never acts serious, likes to tease her workers and fool around with them. Apparently, our hero is quickly becoming her main target, and now he has to adapt to his new office life with this "devil boss".

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2089060/]Steam[/url]]
